# Petrified [Condition]

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Conditions](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#PetrifiedCondition)*

While you have the Petrified condition, you experience the following effects.

***Turned to Inanimate Substance.*** You are transformed, along with any nonmagical objects you are wearing and carrying, into a solid inanimate substance (usually stone). Your weight increases by a factor of ten, and you cease aging.

***Incapacitated.*** You have the [Incapacitated](Incapacitated.md) condition.

***Speed 0.*** Your [Speed](../Movement/Speed.md) is 0 and can't increase.

***Attacks Affected.*** Attack rolls against you have [Advantage](../D20-Tests/Advantage.md).

***Saving Throws Affected.*** You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity [saving throws](../D20-Tests/Saving-Throw.md).

***Resist Damage.*** You have [Resistance](../Combat/Damage-and-Healing/Resistance.md) to all damage.

***Poison Immunity.*** You have [Immunity](../Combat/Damage-and-Healing/Immunity.md) to the [Poisoned](Poisoned.md) condition.
